articles.title: GHSA: Traefik: ForwardAuth middleware leaks X-Forwarded-Port spoofing via untrusted X-Forwarded-Proto when trustForwardHeader=false
articles.summary:
## Summary

There is a medium severity vulnerability in Traefik's ForwardAuth middleware. Even when configured with `trustForwardHeader: false`, Traefik derives the `X-Forwarded-Port` header sent to the authentication service from the original incoming request instead of the sanitized forwarded request. As a result, an unauthenticated remote attacker can inject an `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` header
